principle: match visible material, typography, spacing and motion—not only structure and timestamps

production_route.pptx: transparent raster illustration layers plus native editable text; only simple containers remain native shapes
production_route.video: reuse the same transparent illustration layers, animate each layer on the measured reference path
forbidden: generic SVG/demo primitives replacing reference illustration material
baking editable Chinese labels into generated images
inventing brand logo or branded packshot pixels

typography.observation: reference uses heavy, compact, slightly rounded Chinese display text; v2 PingFang treatment is too regular and too small
typography.gate: render one reference title and all three navigation labels in the three candidate fonts; choose by side-by-side visual weight before rebuilding

navigation_geometry_at_1275x720_analysis.note: verify final pill boundaries from high-resolution thresholded crops; use equal perceived clear space rather than raw group X values so item 1 and item 2 never read as touching

observed_motion: previous three cards clear, leaving open silk background
orange ribbon starts very small at upper center
ribbon scales to final size with a short eased settle
chapter title grows with the ribbon; it is not a static full-size cut

observed_layers: orange speech bubble with tail and white text
observed_motion: navigation arrives as a separated row, item 1 active
package group scales/slides upward from lower center
甲 and 乙 bursts pop in separately
speech bubble enters from the right with visible tilt, rotation settle and scale-up
microshot_findings.implementation: generate the bubble and decorative marks as transparent text-free PNG layers; overlay native editable text; animate rotation, scale and translation independently

observed_motion: R06 content clears before the white stage enters
cell appears first, then virus content accumulates
left treatment label and orange mechanism assemble in steps
virus count visibly reduces/fades after the orange block
gray release path and right medicine appear later
outgoing particles and frequency information accumulate rather than appearing as one static diagram
microshot_findings.implementation: use several transparent illustration PNG layers and masks; do not rebuild the finished scene from basic ellipse/arrow SVG shapes

observed_motion: patient and family/shield enter from opposite sides
orange particles drift from patient toward the shield
particles stop or disappear at the shield boundary
final frame has no white rectangular image background
microshot_findings.implementation: patient, particles, shield and family must be separate transparent PNG layers; the shield interior may be white but the outer canvas must be alpha-transparent

static: transparent-edge check on checkerboard and final silk background
no producer labels or white image rectangles
motion: position tolerance within 2 percent of frame
major cue timing tolerance within 0.10 seconds
reference vs replica overlay and side-by-side at each semantic node
release_sequence: approve one R06 three-second bubble proof
approve one R07 mechanism motion proof
approve one R08 transparent integration proof
only then rebuild the full 27.44-second gate and PPTX

prevention_loop: classify every reference layer as native text, native simple shape, transparent raster illustration, or authorized brand asset before implementation
lock font tokens and object measurements in one scene contract
do not accept technical QA as fidelity QA
require representative still and three-frame motion signoff before expanding a scene family
record every rejected fidelity pattern in tasks/lessons.md and the lesson registry
